# Verto

> Verto is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop app for Linux, Windows and macOS that converts images, documents, audio and video files entirely on the user's machine. No upload, no account, no telemetry. Conversions use engines bundled in the app: a Rust image library, FFmpeg and Pandoc.

- Platforms: Linux x86_64 (AppImage, .deb, .rpm), Windows x86_64 (.exe, .msi), macOS on Apple Silicon (.dmg).
- Categories: images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, ICO; HEIC, PSD, EXR as input), documents (Markdown, DOCX, HTML, ODT, EPUB, LaTeX; PDF as output), audio (MP3, FLAC, WAV, OGG, AAC, Opus and more), video (MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, AVI and more).
- Network: conversions work offline. The only network request is a check for new releases on GitHub at launch.
- Built with Tauri v2 (Rust) and Vue 3.
